reason: A UI enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds a configurable right sidebar for navigation, workspace and session breadcrumbs, session overviews, trajectory viewing, and log downloads.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可配置的右侧边栏，用于导航工作区与会话、查看会话概览和轨迹，并下载会话日志。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable right sidebar to DeepSeek Harness for workspace and session navigation, session overviews, trajectory viewing, and log downloads.

capabilities: Adds a configurable right-side navigation sidebar to the DeepSeek Harness web UI
Displays workspace and session navigation, session overview data, trajectory views, and log statistics
Provides one-click session log ZIP downloads
Persists plugin settings locally and installs the dsh-better-session-title child plugin
